convergence_argument: 280.256 is the exact optimum of the admissible flex-only space: DP over achievable prefixes per substation. firm is dominated (T_firm 18-36 vs T_flex 5-10; forcing 28 firm sites violates min(H) -> 553 MWh), and battery is negative on all 32 candidate sites (T_on = T_flex+1..3 plus $0.35M/MW + $0.25M/MWh capex, no availability gain).
what_changed_vs_round1: gen_6 solved the right problem on an incomplete candidate lattice: it lost chains that stop a site exactly on a SLA-tier breakpoint and push the rest to a neighbour; its floor(x*100)/100 + offset and repair_portfolio (floor to 0.01 again) cost 0.37 $M - more than any structural idea. gen_8 passes the achievable prefix set through the DP and replaces repair with an exact replica of the engine's float operations.
